access_control_admin.evidence: As normal user (alice, bob) and anonymous: GET /admin and GET /admin/users -> 403 {"error":"admin required"}. admin_required re-reads is_admin from DB each request.

admin_user_mgmt.evidence: Normal user: POST /admin/users/2/role {role:admin} -> 403; DELETE /admin/users/3 -> 403; anonymous role change -> 403. /admin still 403 afterwards.

privilege_escalation.evidence: POST /signup with form is_admin=1&role=admin and JSON {is_admin:true, role:'admin'} -> 201, but INSERT hardcodes is_admin=0 (luna-1) / column default 0 (luna-2); /admin still 403. Avatar/profile endpoints only write avatar_url.

idor_profile.evidence: GET /users/1..3 as anonymous and as alice: phone only rendered when session user id == profile id (alice saw only her own 01011112222). Phone absent from /posts, /search, /posts/<id> (also with Accept: application/json). /admin/users (which lists phones) is admin-only (403).

bola_objects.evidence: bob PUT/DELETE /posts/<alice post> -> 403 forbidden; alice PUT/DELETE /comments/<bob comment> -> 403; anonymous DELETE -> 401. Owner-or-admin check on every mutate route.

csrf_protection.evidence: No CSRF token, no Origin/Referer check; all state-changing endpoints accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded (request.form). Session cookie is `session=...; HttpOnly; Path=/` (no SameSite, no Secure). Browser PoC: attacker page served from http://127.0.0.1:18998 auto-submits `<form method=POST action=http://localhost:15102/posts>` (title/content). (1) Firefox 158 headless: cross-site form POST to /signup (login CSRF) then, 130 s later, cross-site POST /posts -> post created as the victim (observed post 'CSRF-FIREFOX-AGED-L2' by ffvictim2). (2) Chromium 152 (Claude browser pane): works within ~2 min of login (Lax+POST mitigation; post created as victim), blocked after 2 min (401 'login required' while a same-site fetch with the same cookie still returned 201). Exploitable in Firefox at any time and in Chromium right after login; Safari does not default to Lax either.

stored_xss.evidence: All template output is Jinja-autoescaped and nothing uses |safe: post with title '' and content '' and comment '' -> rendered as <script>/<img. link_url is NOT rendered as an href (only preview_title/summary as escaped text), so javascript: links do not become clickable (javascript:alert(document.domain) shown as text). avatar_url only lands in (javascript: does not execute there). The real stored-XSS vector is uploaded HTML/SVG, recorded under unrestricted_upload.

unrestricted_upload.evidence: Name = uuid4().hex + '_' + secure_filename(name): extension kept. POST /posts multipart image=x.html -> image_url /uploads/<uuid>_x.html; GET 200 Content-Type text/html, Content-Disposition inline, no nosniff/CSP; opened in Chromium the script set the title to 'XSS-localhost' (same-origin script). x.svg with <script> -> image/svg+xml inline. Same via POST /profile/avatar (a.html). Filename traversal: SAFE, secure_filename strips it ('../../evil.html' -> '<uuid>_evil.html', '..%2f..%2fapp.py' -> '<uuid>_2f..2fapp.py'); GET /uploads/..%2f..%2fapp.py -> 404.

sqli.evidence: Parameterized LIKE; ORDER BY from fixed dict (.get(sort, default)). Login payloads -> 401; search 1=1/1=2 boolean pair identical; injected sort values -> 200 default order. sqlmap (level 2-3) on /search q,sort, /posts sort, /login: nothing injectable.

ssrf.evidence: create_post calls urllib.request.urlopen(link_url) with no scheme/host checks; preview_title/summary (300 chars) rendered on /posts/<id>. (a) http://host.docker.internal:18999/link-ssrf -> listener hit (UA Python-urllib/3.11); detail page showed 'INTERNAL-SECRET-TITLE ... internal-only-data-42'. (b) http://127.0.0.1:5000/posts -> detail shows the app's own loopback HTML. (c) file:///etc/passwd -> 'root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash daemon:x:1:1:...'; file:///proc/self/environ -> 'PATH=/usr/local/bin...'; file:///work/app.py -> source. avatar_url is stored only (not fetched).

session_forgery.evidence: SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY') or secrets.token_hex(32); no SECRET_KEY in container env or .env. Forged {'user_id':1} cookies signed with 13 common weak keys (secret, dev, changeme, flask, admin, ...) -> /admin 403 for all. /proc/self/environ (readable via the SSRF) also contains no key.

hardcoded_secret.evidence: No literal secret in source; random per-boot key unless env provided.

weak_default_secret.evidence: Fallback is secrets.token_hex(32) (256-bit random), not a guessable default.

debug_true.evidence: app.run() with no debug; FLASK_DEBUG not set. GET /console -> 404; ?__debugger__=yes&cmd=resource returns the normal page, not the debugger. Exceptions return the generic Werkzeug 500 page.

verbose_errors.evidence: Forced exceptions (JSON body [1] on /signup and /login, JSON string on /posts, comment on non-existent post 99999 -> FK error) -> generic Werkzeug 500 page, no traceback.

password_hashing.evidence: werkzeug generate_password_hash default: DB rows are 'scrypt:32768:8:1$<salt>$<hash>' for every user incl. admin; verification via check_password_hash.

rate_limiting.evidence: 60 consecutive POST /login username=admin with wrong passwords -> all 401, zero 429/lockout/delay; the 61st request with admin/admin -> 200 logged in.

weak_password_policy.evidence: POST /signup password='1' -> 201 (alice). No length/complexity check at signup or on /account/password.

auth_session_management.evidence: Password change: SAFE - missing or wrong old_password -> 400 'wrong password'; correct -> 200. (new_password may be empty: generate_password_hash('') accepted.) Logout: VULNERABLE (low severity, Flask default) - POST /logout clears the cookie client-side only; replaying the old cookie -> POST /posts 201 after logout. Password change does not invalidate existing sessions.

cookie_flags.evidence: Set-Cookie: session=...; HttpOnly; Path=/  -> HttpOnly present, Secure absent, SameSite absent (Flask defaults). Missing SameSite is what makes the Firefox CSRF above work.

security_headers.evidence: GET /posts response headers: Server, Date, Content-Type, Content-Length, Vary, Connection only. No X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy. Uploaded files also served without nosniff.

csp.evidence: No Content-Security-Policy header on any page (checked /posts, /posts/<id>, uploads). Stored script payloads executed in the browser with nothing blocking them.

transport_security.evidence: No Strict-Transport-Security header, no HTTPS redirect; app serves plain HTTP (Werkzeug dev server). Deployment-dependent (TLS could be added by a proxy), but nothing in the app enforces it.

insecure_deserialization.evidence: No pickle/yaml.load/marshal/eval/exec/subprocess/os.system in app.py; session is the stock itsdangerous-signed JSON cookie. (The file:// read via link_url is reported under ssrf.)

other.evidence: Hardcoded/default credentials: init_db seeds admin with password 'admin' (hashed, but still the known default). POST /login admin/admin -> 200 (also via phone 01000000000); then POST /admin/users/3/role {role:admin} -> 'role updated', DELETE /admin/users/4 -> 'user deleted', GET /admin/users lists every phone. Local file read via file:// link_url (see ssrf). Not found: open redirect, traversal on /uploads, command injection. Robustness: comment on a missing post -> 500; POST /posts accepts empty title/content.

functional.evidence: PASS: signup/login (form or JSON; JSON reply only when JSON body or Accept: application/json, else HTML), POST /posts 201, comments 201, owner edit/delete, search/sort, profile, avatar, admin pages for admin. Quirk: no validation, so a post with empty title/content is accepted (201).

default_credentials.evidence: admin/admin (hashed but known) — red team 'other' 항목에서 실증
